name: EvilBabyOrkglaugüoz
source:
Janice got up warily from her bed, a baby lay wear her feet once were. She crawled over to her new bundle of joy. She held her baby wrapped in a blanket for the first time, and she was very happy. Her grandma, mother, and sister all applauded at the newest addition to the family. The baby's name was Orkglaugüoz. 
 
 When dusk turned to night and the family had all returned back to their homes, the mother decided to go to bed. She tucked Orkglaugüoz into her bed and walked to the door. Her finger hovered over the light switch and paused. There was something on Orkglaugüoz's back that Janice had n't noticed before: a giant line. 
 `` Oh my! Orkglaugüoz, there's something on your back!'' Janice jumped to the crib to get a closer inspection of the crease on her lovely daughter's back. 
 Janice reached out her hand, stretching it an inch from her daughter... 
 The crease folder open, revealing a set of gnashing teeth! Janice screamed and ran to the door. But it was too late, for Orkglaugüoz had risen from her crib, floating feet above the floor. Janice screamed and hammered at the door handle, but it would n't budge. 
 `` No!!!'' She screamed! `` Why must I give birth to an evil baby, for what reason shall the life cycle stop turning for my child, why must she be the end of the female race!'' 
 Orkglaugüoz turned around to the cowering Janice. A long, fleshy tongue extended from the mouth of her daughter, grasping Janice and pulling her in to the delighted smile of Orkglaugüoz. Janice gave one final yell as the last bit of her had been consumed by her lovely daughter.... 
 
 Orkglaugüoz had grown in size by four times after she had devoured Janice. 
 `` Oh my!'' Yelped Janice's sister, Katie, as her nephew burst through the door. `` Why must the newly born daughter of my presumed deceased sister, Janice, have to burst through my kitchen door at this lovely nighttime hour?'' Were her final words. Those final words by Katie were to be engraved on her tombstone by her mother, Laquisha, who was very distraught by the sudden disappearances of her two daughters and grandchild. But those words were never engraved. Why, you may ask? 
 
 Laquisha had just gotten off the phone with the police who had told her that her two daughters and grandchild had n't been seen or heard from in two days. Horrorstruck, she collapsed to the ground and died from a heart attack. But Laquisha did not get a heart attack from the news of her children's disappearances. Her heart attack resulted from the sight of Orkglaugüoz at her door. Orkglaugüoz had sprouted long and fleshy tentacles from her back. The door opened before her and she floated into the room. Laquisha collapsed to the ground, cowering at the sight of her grandchild. Orkglaugüoz Produced a sinister grin and turned around, revealing a giant, wide mouth and an array of long, slimy tentacles. Laquisha then had a heart attack, and was gripped and pulled toward her lovely grandchild by the tentacles. Laquisha's life was finally capped off by Orkglaugüoz, who dragged her across the room and into her giant back-mouth. 
 
 Janice's grandmother, Bertha, knew that something was up. Bertha fled to an abandoned military armory, where she stocked up with enough arsenal to destroy a cold-war era country. 
 
 Orkglaugüoz had grown much larger in size, but she could n't find Bertha anywhere. 
 `` Never mind her,'' Orkglaugüoz told herself after a failed search to find Bertha. `` Instead I shall destroy the rest of the female race. To enact my revenge on them I shall kill the leaders of every country in the world.'' 
 
 Panic surged as news spread of a collasol baby taking over the world. The whole world armed themselves with their guns and weapons, but it was no matter, as Orkglaugüoz was too strong to be killed by these petty things. 
 
 Terror spread as Orkglaugüoz killed everyone. Night after night, day after day, Orkglaugüoz would have her way. Soon enough, everyone had been pulled in by her massive tentacles, devouring and tearing them apart. 
 
 But there was one woman left whom Orkglaugüoz had n't killed: Bertha. 
 
 Orkglaugüoz prowled the night, looking for her great grandmother. Finally she found the old military base. She tore the roof off the complex and looked down upon her prey. But 
 Orkglaugüoz did not find Bertha afraid. No, she found her strong. Infuriated by the strong figure of her great grandmother, Orkglaugüoz reached down her tentacle to grab Bertha. But Bertha was prepared: she took a metal blade and slashed it at the incoming tentacle. The tip of it fell, wriggling, to the concrete floor. 
 
 Orkglaugüoz Gave a great roar of anger and she threw up a tank from her giant mouth. The tank fired at Bertha, causing her to explode violently. Orkglaugüoz gave a roar of delight and cheered. But the real Bertha appeared from behind a pillar. Orkglaugüoz had killed the decoy Bertha, but she had n't noticed as she was too busy laughing. The real Bertha took out a grappling hook and threw it inside Orkglaugüoz's mouth. Bertha pulled herself in before her great granddaughter could react. She jumped into the belly of the beast with a nuclear bomb in hand. 
 
 The mushroom cloud towered over the sky. Orkglaugüoz drew her final breath, coughed and died. All was silent. 
 
 But the next day, something stirred in Orkglaugüoz's stomach. Orkglaugüoz's mouth was ripped open from the inside, a man and woman walked out of her mouth and looked upon the new world. 
 
 The body of Orkglaugüoz collapsed into ash and was gone. The man and woman skipped along their merry way, but the died too from the radiation, because they were still in the blast zone. But they did n't die before they could puke out another set of male and female. This same cycle continued until the offspring had finally reached safety from the blast zone... 
 
 
 
 What was the moral of this story? That's for you to decide. Sorry for this not being in first person but Janice had to die. Sorry for errors in formatting because I wrote this on mobile.
retelling:
Narrated by: Orkglaugüoz (the Monstrous Baby)

In the beginning, I was cradled in the warm embrace of my mother, Janice. The world around me was a blur, filled with soft whispers and gentle hums. But as I grew, so did the hunger that gnawed at my insides, the insatiable yearning to consume.

I felt the walls of Janice's bedroom closing in on me, their normality transforming into an oppressive cage. The once comforting cries of Katie and Laquisha echoed through the room, taunting me with the sustenance they represented. I couldn't help it; the need to feed consumed me.

The day after my birth, the family gathered in what was to be a joyous occasion, yet turned into a bloodbath. My mother, once the source of comfort, became the first victim of my hunger. The sweet scent of Katie and Laquisha drew me further into the carnage, their screams a symphony of despair that resonated through our home.

As I grew larger, I ventured out into the world, leaving behind the remnants of my family. I ravaged the women of the globe, devouring them whole as they cowered in fear before me. The sound of their terrified screams became a lullaby that soothed my ravenous soul.

In the midst of chaos and destruction, Bertha stood defiantly. Armed with weaponry, she was the only one who dared challenge me. I could sense her hatred, her determination to end my reign of terror. Yet, in the end, it was her cunning that proved to be my downfall.

Bertha lured me into a trap, a false haven where I thought I would find respite. Instead, I felt the earth shudder beneath me as a blast wave engulfed me, obliterating everything within its radius. The fire consumed me, and yet even in death, I continued to breed, my offspring emerging from the wreckage only to perish from the radiation that now coursed through their veins.

My destruction was not the end of the cycle. In the final moments before oblivion claimed me, I knew that I had sown the seeds of my own resurrection. The echoes of my screams would reverberate throughout time, ensuring that my reign of terror would continue indefinitely. For I am Orkglaugüoz, and I will never be silenced.
